AI-edited group illustration

The About-section conversation circle is an AI-edited illustration based on a user-supplied reference image, updated to include a racially diverse group of adults. It does not depict an actual TTP session or establish any participant's health status.

The homepage main conversation photo (support-conversation.jpg) and smaller community-circle photo (community-circle.jpg) were supplied and selected by the site owner for illustrative use. They do not identify actual TTP clients or staff.
